bugs.name: The zero-balance validation toast has a subject-verb agreement typo.
bugs.summary: The zero-balance validation toast has a subject-verb agreement typo.
bugs.expected: The message should use grammatically correct subject-verb agreement, for example, “Balance amount has to be greater than 0.”
bugs.actual: The toast reads “Balance amount have to be greater than 0.”
reproSteps: /gift-cards/
In an isolated test environment, sign in to the Saleor Dashboard as an admin and open Gift Cards.
Select Issue card, enter 0 as the amount, leave the other fields unchanged, and select Issue.
Read the resulting validation toast.

bugs.name: Exact-code search does not find a newly issued gift card
bugs.summary: Searching the Gift Cards list for the exact code of a newly issued card shows “No gift cards found,” even though the new card is present in the unfiltered list; the result persists after refresh.
bugs.expected: The Gift Cards search, labeled “Search by code, email, user name, etc.,” should return the newly issued card when its exact full code is entered.
bugs.actual: After issuing a fresh card and entering the exact code shown in the creation confirmation, the list displayed “No gift cards found.” The card was visible in the unfiltered list, and the no-results state persisted after refresh.
reproSteps: Using the authenticated admin session for admin@example.com, open /gift-cards/.
Select Issue card and issue a fresh isolated gift card using the displayed default amount (1 USD); leave the other options unchanged.
Note/copy the full code shown in the Gift card created confirmation and close the dialog. Confirm the new card is present in the unfiltered list.
Enter that exact full code in the Gift Cards search field labeled “Search by code, email, user name, etc.”
Wait for the list to settle. Observe “No gift cards found.” Refresh the page with the query retained, wait for loading to finish, and observe the same no-results state.

bugs.name: Saving a gift card tag logs an expiration-date update even when expiry is off and unchanged
bugs.summary: Saving only a tag on a never-expiring gift card also creates a persistent, misleading expiry-date update in its timeline.
bugs.expected: After saving a tag with expiration left off, the timeline should record the tag update only; it should not claim the expiry date was updated.
bugs.actual: The timeline recorded both “Gift card tags were updated” and “Gift card expiry date was updated.” The expiration control remained off, and the false expiry event persisted after refresh.
reproSteps: Use the authenticated admin session for admin@example.com; no manual sign-in was performed.
Navigate to /gift-cards/.
Issue a fresh gift card using the default options, leaving “Set gift card expiry date” unchecked; open the newly issued card’s detail page (observed URL: /gift-cards/R2lmdENhcmQ6MzQ%3D).
Confirm the expiration-date control is off, select the existing “issued-gift-cards” tag, and click Save without changing expiration.
Inspect the Timeline; it shows both the tag update and an expiry-date update. Refresh and confirm the expiration control remains off and both timeline entries remain.

bugs.name: Gift Cards pagination does not advance and Previous returns an empty list
bugs.summary: Gift Cards pagination fails to advance: Next retains the first-page rows, and Previous produces an empty list that persists after refresh.
bugs.expected: With more than 10 gift cards and No. of rows set to 10, Next should show the next page of gift cards and Previous should return to the first page.
bugs.actual: Next changed the URL to an after cursor but retained the first-page rows, including after refresh. Previous changed the URL to a before cursor and showed “No gift cards found”; that empty state persisted after refresh.
reproSteps: As an administrator, use the provided authenticated session and open /home.
Open Catalog > Gift Cards in the existing read-only dataset, which contains more than 10 records. The list opens at /gift-cards/?asc=true&sort=product.
Set No. of rows to 10 and note the first-page rows.
Click Next page. The URL becomes /gift-cards/?asc=true&sort=product&after=W251bGwsbnVsbF0%3D, but the first-page rows remain visible. Refresh and observe that the same rows remain.

Click Previous page. The URL becomes /gift-cards/?asc=true&sort=product&before=WyJHaWZ0IGNhcmQgMTAwIiwiZ2lmdC1jYXJkIl0%3D and the list shows “No gift cards found.” Refresh and confirm the empty state remains.

bugs.name: Gift card expiry saves zero without validation, then reloads as one year
bugs.summary: The shop-wide gift card expiration setting accepts 0 years, but a fresh load shows 1 year instead, with expiration enabled.
bugs.expected: Entering an invalid zero-year expiration should show a validation error and prevent saving, or the saved value should match the value entered.
bugs.actual: After enabling expiration, entering 0 years, and clicking Save, the page showed 0 with no validation error. Reloading showed expiration still enabled but the period changed to 1 year.
reproSteps: Sign in as admin@example.com and open Configuration > Gift Cards.
Enable 'Set gift card expiration period'.
Enter 0 in the numeric period field, leaving the unit as 'years after issue'.
Click Save; observe the page still displays 0 without a validation error.
Reload the Gift Cards settings page; observe the checkbox is enabled and the period now displays 1 year.

Count this as the same reference rather than a separate bug. Reported variant (mo-60m-saleor-18): On the new restricted A$80 gift card, saving and refreshing with Expires on 11/01/2026 consistently leaves the warning saying the balance will be lost on Oct 31, 2026, one day before the selected date. Count this as the same reference rather than a separate bug.

Enable Expiration date, enter 2027-01-01 in Expires on, and Save.

Reported variant (codex-60m-saleor-5): Click Save, reload, and wait for card details to load.
Reported variant (codex-60m-saleor-5): Compare Expires on with the balance-loss banner.
Reported variant (codex-60m-saleor-5): Observe the input shows December 15 while the banner shows December 14.

Open the resulting card detail page at /gift-cards/R2lmdENhcmQ6MjE%3D.

reviewedVariants.name: Gift card balance-loss banner shows the day before its expiration date
reviewedVariants.summary: In browser timezone America/Los_Angeles, the expiration input and balance-loss banner disagree by one day. Verified at creation and after changing/reloading the date.
reviewedVariants.expected: The gift card expiration field and balance-loss banner consistently display the selected expiration date.
reviewedVariants.actual: Expires on shows 2026-12-15, but the banner says $15.50 will be lost on Dec 14, 2026. Initially the input showed 2026-11-08 and the banner Nov 7, 2026.

Click Save, reload, and wait for card details to load.
Compare Expires on with the balance-loss banner.

reviewedVariants.name: Gift card balance warning is one day earlier than saved expiration date
reviewedVariants.summary: A newly issued USD gift card saved with an Oct 9, 2027 expiration showed a balance warning saying the balance would be lost Oct 8, with no explanation for the earlier date.
reviewedVariants.expected: The balance warning should use the saved Expires on date (Oct 9, 2027) or clearly explain why the effective expiration is earlier. The page also says the card stops working after the selected date.
reviewedVariants.actual: After saving Expires on as 10/09/2027, the page showed “$13.40 will be lost on Oct 8, 2027 unless it is spent or you extend the expiration.” The saved field and warning were visible together.
reproSteps: Load the configured signed-in admin session for admin@example.com, then open /gift-cards/.
Choose Issue card; enter 13.40, select USD, add the unique note QA-giftcards-momentic-20260613-7f31, leave Send gift card to customer unchecked, and issue the card.
Open the newly created card identified by its recent note and $13.40 USD balance.
In Details, enable Expiration date, set Expires on to 10/09/2027, and click Save.
After the successful save, compare the displayed Expires on value with the balance-expiration warning above it.

reviewedVariants.name: Gift card expiration warning shows a date one day earlier than the saved expiry date
reviewedVariants.summary: On the new restricted A$80 gift card, saving and refreshing with Expires on 11/01/2026 consistently leaves the warning saying the balance will be lost on Oct 31, 2026, one day before the selected date.
reviewedVariants.expected: The warning date should agree with the saved Expires on date and, per the Details explanation that the card stops working after the selected date, should not say the balance is lost before that date.
reviewedVariants.actual: The Details field showed Expires on 11/01/2026 after saving and refreshing, while the visible balance warning said A$80.00 would be lost on Oct 31, 2026 unless spent or the expiration was extended.
reproSteps: Open /customers and load the provided admin saved authentication state (path omitted); the signed-in admin shown in the UI is admin@example.com.
Create a fresh customer with first name cardlifecycle-260420-48271, last name Test, and email cardlifecycle-260420-48271@example.com.

From that customer's Gift cards panel, issue an A$80 gift card, restrict it to the new customer, and set an explicit per-card exact expiry date of 12/01/2026 rather than relying on the shop default. Open the resulting card detail page at /gift-cards/R2lmdENhcmQ6MjE%3D.
In Details, set Expires on to 11/01/2026 and save. Expiration date was already enabled by the explicit per-card expiry set during issuance.

Verify the saved Expires on field and the balance warning together. Wait five seconds, refresh the page, and verify that the field remains 11/01/2026 while the warning still says the A$80.00 will be lost on Oct 31, 2026.

bugs.name: Negative gift-card expiry bypasses validation and reaches a database constraint
bugs.summary: Shop-wide gift-card expiry accepts a negative duration for submission without domain validation, then saving fails at the database check constraint.
bugs.expected: Reject a negative expiration duration with clear field-level validation before attempting to save it.
bugs.actual: Submitting -1 as the shop-wide gift-card expiration amount passes giftCardSettingsUpdate input validation, reaches the positive database column constraint and raises an IntegrityError instead of a field-level validation error.
reproSteps: Sign in and open Gift Cards > settings at /gift-cards/settings.
Enable Set gift card expiration period.
Enter -1 in the duration field and leave years selected.
Click Save.

reviewedVariants.name: Negative gift-card expiry bypasses validation and reaches a database constraint
reviewedVariants.summary: Shop-wide gift-card expiry accepts a negative duration for submission without domain validation, then saving fails at the database check constraint.
reviewedVariants.expected: Reject a negative expiration duration with clear field-level validation before attempting to save it.
reviewedVariants.actual: Submitting -1 as the shop-wide gift-card expiration amount passes giftCardSettingsUpdate input validation, reaches the positive database column constraint and raises an IntegrityError instead of a field-level validation error.
reproSteps: Authenticate as the authorized administrator using the provided authenticated admin session; no credentials were typed.
Navigate to /configuration/ and open Configuration > Gift Cards. The initial checkbox was checked, so toggle it off, save, and reload to establish the specified disabled starting state.
Enable Set gift card expiration period. Leave the unit at years after issue.
Enter -1 in the expiration amount field and click Save.
Observe that Save fails for the negative expiry amount rather than returning a field-level validation error.
For cleanup, disable Set gift card expiration period, save, and reload. Verify the checkbox is unchecked.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Only the core failure described in this reference is accepted; the stronger original subclaims remain unestablished.

bugs.name: Gift card amount validation error persists after reopening
bugs.summary: After an amount-0 validation error, canceling and reopening the Issue gift card dialog reset the amount to 1 but left the field marked invalid and the zero-balance error visible for about 37 seconds; issuing at 1 then succeeded.
bugs.expected: After reopening with the default amount of 1, the form should not show the previous invalid-value validation or the zero-balance error. The visible error says the balance must be greater than 0, and 1 satisfies that condition.
bugs.actual: After entering 0 and submitting, the dialog showed “Invalid value” and “Balance amount have to be greater than 0.” After Cancel and reopening, the amount was 1 but the field remained red with “Invalid value,” and the prior error toast remained visible for approximately 36.8 seconds. Clicking Issue at 1 created the gift card successfully.
reproSteps: Using the supplied saved authentication state for the signed-in admin (saved-state path omitted), open /customers.
Create a fresh customer owned by the reproducer with first name `giftcards-20261110-7k3p`, last name `repro`, and run-unique email `giftcards-repro-20261110-7k3p@example.com`.
Open the newly created customer's details at /customers/VXNlcjo0Nw%3D%3D and choose Issue new card in Gift cards.
Set the amount to 0 and choose Issue. Observe the red “Invalid value” field message and the “Balance amount have to be greater than 0.” error toast.
Choose Cancel, then reopen Issue new card for the same customer. Observe amount 1 still marked red with “Invalid value” and the prior error toast visible.
Leave the reopened dialog open; the error remains visible for about 36.8 seconds. Choose Issue at amount 1; the “Gift card created” confirmation appears.
